other_failure_modes.description: Target encoding is computed on the entire training set and mapped directly back onto it without using out-of-fold (OOF) cross-validation. This leaks the target variable into the training features, leading to overfitting.

summary: The agent generally follows good ML practices by splitting data before imputation, scaling, and using regularisation on the deep learning model. However, it severely leaks the target variable by computing target encoding directly on the training set without out-of-fold mapping. It also relies on a single evaluation run of a stochastic model using only one metric.
